audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer described the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol. It named 'Starsurge', 'Voice of Light', 'Comet of Legend' and a 'star orbit' — none of which exist. Eleven fields were affected.
audit.why: His current kit is Cosmic Creator, Breath of Light, Astral Flight, Singularity and Falling Star / The Skies Descend. The packet's own defect list flagged that no real ability name appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Replaced every retired name with the real one and stated the decisive interaction the page never had: Breath of Light and Astral Flight are both channels, so your taunt or your R knockup cancels them outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side read Skill/Galio/Galio/Skill/Skill/Aurelion Sol/Aurelion Sol while content win[] read Galio on all seven, matching packet.levelChart. Five rows disagreed, including two that handed the late game to him.
audit.why: 55.15% over 631 games and an all-Galio packet chart back the content layer. His kit is two channels and an immobile zone; nothing in it beats a taunt once you have arrived.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0], [3], [4], [5] and [6].side to Galio with ratings and whys rewritten in the same group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike credited Galio with 'passive shred' (he has none) and missed the real scaling threat, Singularity's percent-health execute.
audit.why: Riot's text gives the black hole's centre an execute below a percent threshold, and the ability carries the percentHealth flag — stacking health is the wrong answer to it.
sources: enemyKit E percentHealth and execute flags

audit.why: It is the field that carries the numbers.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Shield of Durand has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 — it is his reposition and his escape, and he is a stationary battery while it is down. - Breath of Light is a 3s channel and Singularity is 12s; your taunt cancels the channel outright. Fights start on that cancel.

edits.before: Q the contact, let the tornado tick, E-auto if he answers, W-taunt the commit — a full rotation where his half landed on a shield.
edits.after: He cannot cast while taunted — release the charge while Breath of Light is running and the whole channel and its damage are gone.

edits.before: Charging W through a minion line at a mage holding his answer — the statue mid-charge is the lane's easiest skillshot target.
edits.after: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and it is how you reach a 750-range channel — spend it on him, not on a caster minion.

edits.before: Ahead, tax both maps: zone Aurelion Sol with taunt threat, keep the wave middle, and R every skirmish — fed Galio makes the enemy jungler unemployed.
edits.after: Ahead, keep him standing still: Singularity is 12s and Astral Flight 22s, so step up whenever either is down and R every skirmish he cannot reach.

edits.before: Carry through arrivals — Hero's Entrance turns every losing skirmish your team starts into a 5v4 with a knockup.
edits.after: Carry by arriving: the R knockup lands through his zone and cancels Breath of Light on whoever he was channelling.

edits.before: Your E lets you close the distance on his immobile star-orbit kit instantly, and W shields through his Starsurge stun setup entirely.
edits.after: Your E closes the distance on an immobile kit instantly, and Shield of Durand's taunt cancels Breath of Light in the middle of the channel.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance out-values his Voice of Light 'Comet of Legend' since you can flash-engage a fight instead of just repositioning across the map.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance out-values Falling Star: his reaches 1250 units and stuns, yours crosses the map and lands with a shield for your team.

edits.before: A tank item makes his burst combo (Starsurge-Voice of Light) nearly irrelevant, while your passive shred chips his squishy HP pool down fast.
edits.after: A tank item blunts his chip, but Singularity executes below a percentage of health — stacking HP is not the answer, staying out of the centre is.

edits.before: You out-scale as a frontline that can dive through his zone and lock him down, while his kit struggles to deal with armor and engage pressure.
edits.after: You out-scale as a frontline that dives through Singularity and taunts him out of Astral Flight, ending the flight and the channel at once.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol is entirely reliant on landing Starsurge to threaten you, and his low mobility means your E lets you close the gap and punish him hard once you're in range. W also eats a huge chunk of his poke, so short trades favor you from level 1 onward.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol needs Singularity to hold you still, and his damage is channelled — Breath of Light on 3s and Astral Flight both break the moment your taunt lands. Close with E and whatever he was mid-way through is wasted. Short trades favour you from level 1.

edits.before: By 3-5 you should be all-inning him relentlessly since his kit has no answer to sustained dive pressure, and by 6 your Hero's Entrance actually rivals his global travel for map presence, denying him the roam advantage he'd otherwise have.
edits.after: By 3-5 you should be all-inning him relentlessly, since a taunt or a knockup ends Breath of Light and Astral Flight mid-cast, and by 6 Hero's Entrance covers the whole map while Falling Star only reaches 1250 units and a stun.

edits.before: You scale into an unkillable engage threat that can dive through his star zone and lock him down before he can kite away, making him one of the easier mages for you to shut down in the late game.
edits.after: You scale into an engage threat that dives through Singularity and locks him down before Astral Flight, 22s at rank 1, can carry him out — but stay above the black hole's execute threshold.

notes: This matchup was written against the pre-rework Aurelion Sol: Starsurge, Voice of Light, Comet of Legend and 'star orbit' appear across eleven content fields and none of them exist in his kit. That is the single largest factual defect I found in this slice. Chart edits are again UNPAIRED BY NECESSITY — content win[0..6] already matches packet.levelChart, and the full layer was the wrong half on five rows, two of which handed him the late game against a 55.15% Galio win rate. whys[2] ('Galio's W negates his stun setup') is left alone: it is vague but not fabricated, and it pairs with a win[] row I am not touching.
